invariant: a runtime-authored message (kind=runtime_notice) is never a user transcript line; a protocol repair (goal closeout / length continuation) is absent from snapshot and replay entirely and stays only in the model transcript
notes: The protocol-repair half is owned by the runtime's own tests (leveler-app: session_history + interactive snapshot projection); a client cannot assert it because the repair never reaches the wire. This fixture pins the client-side rule for the messages that DO reach it.
title: runtime injection is not a user message
